message.reasoning_content: We need to determine charge(s) based on facts: The defendant Wang 2 stole a black Sony video camera worth 7800 from the bag placed on driver's seat backrest while riding in a van. This is theft of personal property. The label list includes "盗窃". Also possibly "抢夺"? The difference: 抢夺 is taking property by force or threat, while 盗窃 is stealthy taking. Here "乘车途中，被告人王2某乘朱某某及其他车上人员不备之机，盗走..." Means took while they were unprepared, not using force. So it's theft (盗窃). No other crimes. So answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.
